title: Arzo E Karbala
body:
DUR AB KARBALA SE AYE MOWLA EK PAL VHI RAHA NAHI JATA -2
ISS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GAZI NAAM HO ZAYERIN ME MERA
____________
1- QAFLE AAP KI ZIYARAT KO
KITNE MERE WATAN SE JATE HAIN
AOR HAM MUFLISI KE MARE HUE
ASHK BAS ANKH SE BAHATE HAIN -2
AAP BABE MURAD HAIN MAOLA
MOJIZA KUCHH DIKHAIYE AYESA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
______________
2- QALBE MUZTAR KO AASRA DE DO
APNE BIMAR KO SHIFA DE DO
KOI UMMEED TO NAZAR AAYE
MUJHKO JEENE KA HAOSLA DE DO -2
DIL ME HASRAT LIYE NA MAR JAU SUN LO MERI YE ILTEJA MAULA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
_______________
3- JAUN PAIDAL NAJAF SE KARBOBALA , HO NIGAON ME AAP KA RAOZA
KHWAHISHE KHULD VHI NA HO US DAM , DIL ME MERE AYE SHAHE KARBOBALA -2
MERI ANKHO NE KHAB DEKHE HAIN
INKO TABEER DIJIYE AAQA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
___________
4- SUBHA TA SHAM BAS DUA HAY MERI , KASH KISMAT YE MERI KHIL JAYE
ASTANE KI APKE HAMKO , MERE MOWLA GULAMI MIL JAYE -2
KHATM HO INTEZAR KI GHARIYA , APNE DAR PE BULALO BEHRE KHUDA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
________________
5- KISMATE HUR SAWARME WALE, DEE PE SIR APNA WARNE WALE
ZERE KHANJAR HAY KHUSHKE HOTO PAR, NAAM HAK KA PUKARNE WALE -2
SUNLO FARIYAAD APNE SHAYDA KI, WASTA APKO SAKINA KA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
______________
6- AP MUSHKIL KUSHA KE BETE HAY, AP HAJAT RAWA KE BETE HAY
AP HAY MUSTAFA KE DIL KA SUKON, AP KHAIRUN NESA KE BETE HAY -2
BHEEK DE DIJE APNE DAR KI HAME, AYE SHAHE YASRABO SHAHE BATHA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
_____________
7- AKE HUM OW MAKAM DEKHENGE, KHAYI AKBAR NE JIS JAGAH BARCHI
SHEH NE JIS JAA LARAZTE HATO SE, HASHE KARIYAL JAWA UTHAYI THI -2
PARDKE NAWHA JAWAN BETE KA, UMME LAYLA KO DENGE HUM PURSA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI
NAAM HO ZAERIN ME MERA
<<DIVIDER>>
8-KEH KE LABBAIK YA HUSSAIN as CHALEN ,HAM *FIDAYAN E MEHDIYE DAORAN*
MANZAR E KARBALA HO NAZRO ME, AOR LABO PAR HAMARE AAHO FUGHAN -2
HAR AZADAR KI TAMANNA HAI AOR HAR MATAMI KE DIL KI SADA
IS BARAS ARBAEEN ME GHAZI MAAN HO ZAEREEN ME MERA.
